title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript across the DSC 106 labs, with a JS-generated nav, dark mode, and projects loaded from a JSON file.

title: Life Expectancy Gap: Persuasive vs Deceptive Visualization
description: DSC 106 group project using World Bank human development data, showing how design choices can make the same data persuade or mislead.

title: Grocery Foods: Processing vs Nutrition
description: DSC 106 expository visualization. A two-panel chart comparing how processed foods are against their sugar, sodium, and price per calorie.

title: Historical Redlining and Environmental Burden
description: Group research project linking 1930s HOLC redlining grades to modern pollution burden in San Diego using OLS regression and Welch's t-test (r = 0.63, p = 0.012).

title: Summit Ridge DataHub
description: Case study with Supabase, a Python data ingestion pipeline, and an LLM-powered one-pager generator.

title: Lunara: Women's Health App
description: Women's health app prototype built with React Native and Expo, plus a landing page with scroll-driven animation and a brand identity designed from scratch.

title: Statistical Inference in R
description: Coursework covering interaction models, logistic regression, partial F-tests, bootstrapping, and time series analysis with ARIMA.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Problem sets on SVMs, ridge regression, Bayes classifiers, QDA, Naive Bayes, decision trees, and density estimation, written up in LaTeX.

title: Predicting U.S. Power Outage Duration
description: Full modeling pipeline on 1,500+ outage records with feature engineering, permutation tests, gradient boosting, and a fairness audit across subgroups.

title: Consumer Transaction Analysis at Cash2u
description: Internship analysis of 50,000+ installment payment transactions to find behavior trends and turn them into recommendations for leadership.

title: Relational Database Design
description: SQL coursework on E/R diagrams, BCNF decomposition, and transaction scheduling.

title: Python Game Development Workshop
description: Workshop I ran as President of Women in Computer Science at Diablo Valley College, teaching students to build a simple game in Python.
